title: Course Span Schedule for Lengthening Visit Referrals
content:
When an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is lengthened, the course span follows the referral's state and its use:

- where the referral is exhausted and at least one unit use on it falls within the two months before the handling date, the course span is the active-course span: the type's extension validity days plus 24 days;
- where the referral is approved and still has units remaining, the course span is the open-course span of 56 days;
- otherwise the course span is the type's extension validity days.

A unit use is a unit-use entry on the referral's own unit ledger, dated by the visit that used it; the status and the units remaining are read from the referral.

## Spans by type (calendar days)

| Referral type | Extension validity days | Active-course span (exhausted, recent use) | Open-course span (approved, units remaining) | Any other case |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | 90 | 114 | 56 | 90 |
| HMO Specialist Referral | 90 | 114 | 56 | 90 |
| Out-of-Network Referral | 60 | 84 | 56 | 60 |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | 30 | 54 | 56 | 30 |

## Cases (hypothetical referrals)

- An exhausted Physical Therapy Episode Authorization whose last visit was three weeks before the handling date: the span is 54 days.
- An exhausted HMO Specialist Referral with no unit use in the two months before the handling date: the span is 90 days.
- An approved Out-of-Network Referral with one visit remaining: the span is 56 days.
- An approved In-Group Specialist Referral with no units remaining: the span is 90 days.
